statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH (yellow). Tail steps up into the watch band because the post-keynote recovery failed and NQ has marked a new session low against an extending front-end repricing, while conflicting megacap breadth and a subdued volatility surface keep it well below the block threshold.
recommendation: Conditions are described as a semiconductor-led rotation inside a post-event whipsaw rather than a broad index de-rating, with the residual conditional risk concentrated in the narrow 16:00Z-18:00Z window. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain active throughout.
headline: NQ gives back the post-Warsh recovery and marks a new session low as chips lead lower, lifting Tail into the watch band while megacap strength keeps the broad tape orderly
body:
The post-keynote recovery has failed. NQ futures trade at 29,512.75, down 0.62% on the day, after printing a new session low at 29,493.00; the contract had recovered the entire post-speech decline to reach 29,811.50 earlier in the hour. The Nasdaq-100 cash index is 29,447.05, down 0.66% from Thursday's 29,641.56 close, inside a 29,411.35-29,752.78 day range and close to its own session low. That reversal invalidates the prior read that the event response had resolved, and it is why Tail steps up from 14 into the watch band.

The composition of the decline is the reason Tail stops at 20 rather than moving toward the block threshold. This is a rotation, not an index-wide liquidation. The PHLX Semiconductor Index is 11,484.44, down 3.35% and near its 11,463.79 session low, with Nvidia at 220.31, down 3.37%. Against that, Microsoft is 516.70, up 2.30% and near its 517.14 session high, and the S&P 500 is 7,715.70, down only 0.20%. Megacap breadth is therefore in conflict with the chip leg, and conflicting internal breadth normally raises Stress rather than Tail.

Volatility is not confirming a stress event. VIX is 14.43, down 0.55% on the day and still below Thursday's 14.51 close, inside a 14.13-14.69 range. A market producing a genuine no-retracement path would not normally leave the volatility surface below the prior close. The session has also delivered two complete round trips already, from the post-speech low back to the highs and then back to the lows, which is evidence that mean reversion is functioning rather than failing.

The macro driver is a front-end repricing. Chairman Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote said the Fed's predominant focus right now should be on prices, and reporting puts September rate-hike odds near 50%, roughly doubled from about 35% before the speech. The 2-year yield is 4.35%, up 11 basis points, the 5-year 4.49% (+8.5bp), the 10-year 4.73% (+5.5bp) and the 30-year 5.21% (+1.7bp), a continuing bear-flattening. Higher front-end yields alongside lower equities is genuine cross-asset alignment and is the main reason this hour carries a step up at all. Single-name news is adding to the dispersion without being index-level: Marvell fell sharply after its fiscal 2028 outlook underwhelmed despite a quarterly beat, and PayPal dropped after Advent and Stripe abandoned their pursuit of the company. Oil is inert at 83.26 for WTI, down 0.32%, with no geopolitical amplifier in evidence.

Mapped policy state: WATCH. The evidence-based danger window is narrow, 16:00Z-18:00Z, covering the test of the session low while the repricing is still live. Tail remains well below the block threshold because the observed structure is whipsaw with completed retracements and conflicting internals, not persistent one-way extension. Shared Finviz cross-asset context was checked and found stale at roughly nine hours old, so this assessment rests entirely on independently verified primary sources.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the assessment stayed in the EA_ON state throughout, with Tail between 11 and 17 and Stress between 46 and 57. Thursday's late session and the overnight hours held a narrow futures range with the mode consistently mixed, while Stress drifted up from 46 to 57 through the European morning as the 14:00Z keynote approached. Tail rose to 13 at 13:00Z and 17 at 14:00Z as the speech printed and the first session low was set, then eased to 14 at 15:00Z on what appeared at the time to be a completed recovery. That recovery has since been given back, so the closing hour of the lookback reads more constructively than the current evidence supports. One hour, 10:00Z, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The horizon has three phases. The current 16:00Z hour and the 17:00Z hour carry the watch band and define the narrow 16:00Z-18:00Z danger window: the failed recovery has put price back at the session low while the front-end repricing is still live, and whether 29,493.00 holds is the open question. From 18:00Z the base case is decay as post-event urgency fades, with a small structural step up for the 19:00Z power hour to reflect closing-auction and month-end positioning risk into the Monday turn. The 20:00Z hour is the last full futures hour and conditional Tail falls as the runway shortens. From the 21:00Z Globex weekly halt to the end of the horizon the market is closed, so conditional Tail collapses to a weekend residual and Confidence decays with distance from the last observed evidence; the next real price path arrives at the Sunday 22:00Z reopen, outside this horizon.
